text: As is subtly delineated in the cartoon above, a young scholar is sitting tranquilly beside a window, engrossed in a thick masterpiece, with his mind seemingly wandering across boundless realms of wisdom.
The profound insight implied here is obvious: systematic reading and deep contemplation constitute the most reliable ladder for personal growth and intellectual enlightenment.
Several prominent factors explain why deep reading remains irreplaceable in our fast-paced era.
In the first place, immersing oneself in classic literature enriches mental horizons and cultivates critical thinking, allowing us to perceive complexities beyond superficial appearances.
As Francis Bacon famously remarked, "By reading we enrich the mind."
In the second place, systematic reading serves as an effective antidote to the anxiety and intellectual shallowness triggered by sensationalized short-form videos.
Confronted with fierce social competition, continuous knowledge accumulation alone provides the inner fortitude needed to overcome uncertainty.
In view of the above discussion, young students are encouraged to allocate dedicated time for daily reading and resist mindless digital distractions.
Only when we furnish our minds with profound wisdom can we maintain poise and achieve true greatness.
